verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an open-source CLI (runpodctl) with scriptable commands such as `runpodctl pod create --name NAME --gpu-id ... --image ...`, covering Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and file transfer. Its REST API v1 is explicitly positioned for "workflows and automation systems", supported by API-key authentication, GraphQL, and Python/JS/Go SDKs, so headless automated operation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), documented non-interactive or env-var auth for CLI use in pipelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
